definitions.explanation: extremely strong, dangerous wind, often associated with typhoons

examples.japanese: {暴風|ぼうふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れた→吹き荒れる：08316_fukiareru⟧。
{暴風|ぼうふう}{警報|けいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{暴風|ぼうふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: Trees fell due to the violent wind.

notes:
{暴風|ぼうふう} refers to dangerously strong winds, typically from typhoons or severe storms.

WRITING:
- {暴|ぼう} (violent, outburst)
- ⟦{風|ふう}→風：30892_fuu⟧ (wind)

COMPOUNDS:
- {暴風|ぼうふう}{警報|けいほう}, {暴風|ぼうふう}{特別|とくべつ}{警報|けいほう}: storm warning, emergency storm warning (the advisory below them is ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}{圏|けん} (storm zone - area of dangerous winds)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}{域|いき} (storm area)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}{雨|う} (heavy rain and wind storm)

USAGE:
- In weather reports, a typhoon's {暴風域|ぼうふういき} is the area where average winds reach 25 m/s or more; {暴風域|ぼうふういき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter the storm zone) means the worst winds have arrived

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴風|ぼうふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (violent wind blows)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ (to be hit by a storm)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage from violent wind)
- {暴風|ぼうふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧ (flights canceled due to storm)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧ (strong wind - less severe)
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (typhoon)
- ⟦{突風|とっぷう}→突風：15921_toppuu⟧ (gust)
- ⟦{竜巻|たつまき}→竜巻：06359_tatsumaki⟧ (tornado)

REGISTER: Neutral to formal. Common in weather reports and news.
